cases.attack: failed fence is excluded by actual aggregator
cases.assertions_and_conditions:
def test_failed_fence_is_excluded_by_actual_aggregator(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            (root / "bounded.log").write_text(log(26))
            (root / "warm.log").write_text(perf())
            (root / "failed.log").write_text(perf())
            rows = [{"label": "bounded", "log": "bounded.log", "exit": 0},
                    {"label": "fence-0", "log": "warm.log", "exit": 0, "warmup": True},
                    {"label": "fence-1", "log": "failed.log", "exit": 1, "warmup": False}]
            report = {"head": "fixture", "platform": "fixture", "race_controls": [], "rounds": 1,
                      "variants": {"baseline": {"runs": rows}}}
            (root / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report))
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()): summarize(root)
            result = json.loads((root / "comparison.json").read_text())["variants"]["baseline"]
            self.assertEqual(result["timings"], {})
            rows[-1]["exit"] = 0
            (root / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report))
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()): summarize(root)
            self.assertTrue(json.loads((root / "comparison.json").read_text())["variants"]["baseline"]["timings"])

def test_inline_failure(self):
        text = log().replace("test.t2...OK", "test.t2...FAIL (SpawnFailed)").replace("All 2 tests passed.", "1 passed; 0 skipped; 1 failed.")
        parsed = parse(text, 2)
        self.assertTrue(parsed["validation"]["complete"])
        self.assertEqual(sum(x["status"] == "failed" for x in parsed["case_results"]), 2)

def test_negative_rounds(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            output = Path(directory) / "not-created"
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name("run.py")), "--output", str(output), "--rounds", "-1"], capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2); self.assertFalse(output.exists())

def test_skipped_not_passed(self):
        text = log().replace("test.t2...OK", "test.t2...SKIP").replace("All 2 tests passed.", "1 passed; 1 skipped; 0 failed.")
        parsed = parse(text, 2)
        self.assertTrue(parsed["validation"]["complete"])
        self.assertEqual(sum(x["status"] == "passed" for x in parsed["case_results"]), 2)

def test_zero_exit_cannot_hide_failure(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            fake = log().replace("test.t2...OK", "test.t2...FAIL (Wrong)").replace("All 2 tests passed.", "1 passed; 0 skipped; 1 failed.")
            row = execute([sys.executable, "-c", "print(" + repr(fake) + ")"], root, root / "false-green.log", expected_names=["t1", "t2"])
            self.assertFalse(row["validation"]["complete"])
            self.assertFalse(read_record(root, row, 2)[0]["validation"]["complete"])

cases.attack: cleanup cannot report success with survivors
cases.assertions_and_conditions:
def test_cleanup_cannot_report_success_with_survivors(self):
        with mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "live_session", return_value={100: 1}), \
             mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "LIBC", types.SimpleNamespace(getsid=lambda pid: 999)), \
             mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "send"), \
             mock.patch.object(process_cleanup.time, "monotonic", side_effect=[0, 2]):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError): process_cleanup.cleanup(999)

def test_committed_snapshot_and_independent_copies(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory); repo = root / "repo"; repo.mkdir()
            def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "user.name=PoC", "-c", "user.email=poc@example.invalid", *args], cwd=repo)
            git("init", "-q"); (repo / "value").write_text("committed"); git("add", "value"); git("commit", "-qm", "test")
            head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
            snapshot = root / "snapshot"; freeze(repo, snapshot, head)
            (repo / "value").write_text("concurrent worktree edit")
            candidate = root / "candidate"; copy(snapshot, candidate)
            self.assertEqual((candidate / "value").read_text(), "committed")
            (candidate / "value").write_text("variant mutation")
            self.assertEqual((snapshot / "value").read_text(), "committed")
            self.assertEqual((repo / "value").read_text(), "concurrent worktree edit")

cases.attack: kill order is ancestry not pid order
cases.assertions_and_conditions:
def test_kill_order_is_ancestry_not_pid_order(self):
        graph = {100: 1, 50: 100, 200: 50}
        calls = []
        with mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "live_session", side_effect=[graph, {}, {}]), \
             mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "LIBC", types.SimpleNamespace(getsid=lambda pid: 999)), \
             mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "send", side_effect=lambda pid, sig: calls.append((pid, sig))):
            process_cleanup.cleanup(999)
        self.assertEqual([pid for pid, sig in calls if sig == signal.SIGKILL], [200, 50, 100])

cases.attack: reparented group cleanup after normal exit
cases.assertions_and_conditions:
def test_reparented_group_cleanup_after_normal_exit(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            code = "import os,time; r,w=os.pipe(); p=os.fork();\nif p==0:\n os.setpgid(0,0); os.write(w,b'x'); time.sleep(30)\nelse:\n os.read(r,1); os._exit(0)"
            row = execute([sys.executable, "-c", code], root, root / "normal.log", timeout=2)
            self.assertEqual(row["exit"], 0); self.assertTrue(row["leaked_processes"])

def test_reused_pid_outside_session_is_never_signaled(self):
        with mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "live_session", side_effect=[{100: 1}, {}, {}]), \

             mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "send") as send:
            process_cleanup.cleanup(999)
        send.assert_not_called()

def test_timeout_cleans_separate_process_group(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            code = "import os,time; p=os.fork();\nif p==0: os.setpgid(0,0)\ntime.sleep(30)"
            row = execute([sys.executable, "-c", code], root, root / "timeout.log", timeout=0.5)
            self.assertEqual(row["exit"], "timeout")

cases.attack: worker appearing during cleanup is also killed
cases.assertions_and_conditions:
def test_worker_appearing_during_cleanup_is_also_killed(self):
        calls = []
        with mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "live_session", side_effect=[{100: 1}, {}, {50: 1}, {}]), \
             mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "LIBC", types.SimpleNamespace(getsid=lambda pid: 999)), \
             mock.patch.object(process_cleanup, "send", side_effect=lambda pid, sig: calls.append((pid, sig))):
            found = process_cleanup.cleanup(999)
        self.assertEqual(found, [50, 100])
        self.assertIn((50, signal.SIGKILL), calls)
